title: Scam
body:
Inexistent customer support. Wrote them an email for an issue & 5 days later I still haven’t heard from them.
Also, if you get the plan through their offer in instagram / another app, they say you’ll get lifetime access to the app. But when you install the app, it doesn’t have anywhere to introduce your email address & download already purchased things, so it asks you to re-purchase a lifetime pass. Lovely, isn’t it?

title: bugs and ads
body:
the app is full of ads and bugs. 
I will break them down below. 
the first moment you’re navigating through challenges and ad is thrown up in your face and this happens for every single challenge. 

when you are about to start one you’re promoted to give some sort of rating even though you haven’t done anything thus far aside from watching the same cycle of ads over and over again. 
no matter what star you pick in that rating system that shows up when you want to start a challenge it will start buffering to no end until you tap on x to close the rating system. 

there is literally no information within the daily challenges as it’s just a mere check list with potential challenge and the whole “start the challenge” thing is just to let you check each one daily I guess. 

statistics is broken, not showing anything aside from a calendar. 

the tasks:
you can create tasks and list of tasks which is nice but once you complete the tasks you have created the task is gone forever and it’s not showing anywhere not even on statistics. should have a way to see completed tasks though. 
I would also have expected accepting a challenge to create me a couple of tasks or some habits.

read it’s okayish but just 5 articles there and again those annoying ads showing up each time you want to read something. 

habits:
potentially good but again it’s just some sort of tasks list. the reminder is broken and the button to save the reminder as well. tried to add one habit and i wasn’t able to add reminder on it nor duration of it as nothing gets saved. also the remove from schedule has some sort of delay as i had to remove twice in order to actually work. 

the app has potential and i am looking forward to see how it gets improved in the upcoming future.
